name: ConformanceDeclaration response
abstract: The response for the OGC API conformance declaration resource.
annotatedSchema:
description: 'The URIs of all conformance classes supported by the server.

  To support "generic" clients that want to access multiple OGC API implementations
  - and not "just" a specific API / server, the server declares the conformance classes
  it implements and conforms to.'
content:
  application/json:
    schema:
      $ref: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ogcincubator/bblocks-ogcapi-common/undefined/build/annotated/api/common/part1/schemas/confClasses/schema.yaml
    example:
      conformsTo:
      - http://www.opengis.net/spec/ogcapi-common-1/1.0/conf/core
  text/html:
    schema:
      type: string
